purpose: Fit one deployable rule on all six training dialogues before late panel outcomes. This file does not authorize a new validation or test exposure.
training: Use the same historical first-four-session rule-2 training panel. Take each of the six previously fitted hold-one-dialogue-out source models; for its held dialogue estimate each fixed step by its actual matched two-branch F1. Bag all 6^6 ordered resamples, with the same average-gain maximizer and smaller-step tie rule as for 5^5 in the cross-fits. Fit the native-propensity-matched slopes and offsets once on all six dialogues. These parameters apply to later unseen histories; the formal selection protocol remains in force.
